component.name: Dux Edit
component.summary: Text and document editor for the dux desktop

description.p: Dux Edit is a standalone text, code and Markdown editor for the modern Linux desktop with a Material Design 3 inspired UI. It is built with Quickshell, Qt6, and Go, and pairs with Dux Shell (DMS) for an integrated experience.
It highlights code, checks spelling, previews Markdown, keeps unsaved work across restarts, preserves encodings and line endings, and saves protected files as administrator.
